domain:devx#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvP5Aq9USg5GtmgAAR

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `33b9f44f31db4e1f915867a39e13875a555d0258`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .github/workflows/ci.yml + ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs (outsideTreeReasons), scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs (gateTerm / jobGate / deriveGatedSkips and its ui-deps fixture), scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs, ui/eslint.config.js, ui/eslint-rules/no-inline-spec-config.js, ui/eslint-rules/no-unprefixed-query-params.js, ui/scripts/__tests__/check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts, ui/scripts/__tests__/check-action-forward-parity.test.ts, ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts

Rendered by an isolated subagent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (not the implementer), adopted, with light trimming of its prose and no change to any judgment, by the session named in `Reviewed-by:`. Inputs read: card #28220 body and all six comments (triage 6529894991, seat-2 letter 6529967823, brief-claim 6545296123, ruling 6545651687 letter A, seat-1 stroke 6552157492, claim 6552181644); PR #28501 body, file list (one file, +36/-14) and the net diff of the head against origin/main `ea74ebf93`; the check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set widened, right: the `test-ui` job-level `if:` moves from `ui_tree != 'false' && ui != 'false'` to `ui_tree != 'false' && (ui != 'false' || ui_consumers != 'false')`. This is byte-identical to the conjunct `ui-deps` (ci.yml:3326), `type-check-ui` (:3454) and `build-e2e-ui` (:4315) already carry, so the seven `ui_consumers` globs (ci.yml:566-573) now start the sixteen shards on pull_request, merge_group and push alike. The filter contract's both halves hold: `ui_consumers` is declared with `|| 'true'` (:214) and read through `!= 'false'`, so a dead filter still runs the shards.
- Accept-set of the `Test UI` required context narrowed, right: `test-ui-gate` now explains a `skipped` rollup only when filter succeeded and `ui_tree == false`, or `ui == false AND ui_consumers == false`. That is exactly the negation of the new shards' `if:` under `!cancelled()`, so a skip the shards' own condition does not produce is red. A future revert of the `if:` alone reds the first ui_consumers-only diff; a revert of the gate alone changes nothing. Shell shape `{ a || { b && c; }; }` is valid bash and matches the stated truth table.
- Which tests run: unchanged, right. `outsideTreeReasons` (select-affected-tests.mjs:511-568) returns a reason for any file whose owning outer package is reached from a ui package's dependency fields (transitively through runtime fields), which on this tree is the seven ui_consumers packages; `selectAffectedTests` turns `mode=full` on any reason (:662, :698). So a ui_consumers-only diff is a full battery. The select step in `test-ui` (ci.yml:3833-3870) computes its base the same way for any pull_request / merge_group diff, so nothing in the job assumes a ui path moved.
- Lint UI accept-set unchanged, right under the ruling's own condition: `ui/eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, and the two local rules under `ui/eslint-rules/` read no file. See ③ for the wider Lint UI observation.
- Derived roster of `check-expected-skips`: the parser (`gateTerm`, check-expected-skips.mjs:444-456) reads a parenthesised `||` of `needs.filter.outputs.X != 'false'` terms as one `filter-output` group; the fixture at :1318 and the self-test case at :1526 already pin that spelling for `ui-deps`. The `test-ui` row therefore re-derives to `filter ui_tree + filter ui|ui_consumers` with no edit, which is why the ruling's "update the check-expected-skips derivation / self-test" resolves to no diff. `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` has no ui subject (its four subjects are core / crosspkg / Build Core / Test Core); no parity edit was owed.
- Live tests that pin the `test-ui` `if:` keep passing by inspection: check-pending-changeset-literals.test.ts:199 requires the substring `needs.filter.outputs.ui != 'false'` in the test-ui block (still present inside the parentheses); check-action-forward-parity.test.ts:765 pins the same on `type-check-ui` (untouched); turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts:222-226 requires `ui-deps`, `type-check-ui` and `build-e2e-ui` `if:` to be equal (untouched; test-ui is not in that equality).
- Public surface: none. A root workflow only; no package, schema or export moves.

### ② Semver level

Correct. The PR carries `skip-changeset` and `Clause-②: no`; `Check Changeset` concluded success on the head. The diff publishes nothing (a CI workflow and its comments), so no changeset is owed and no Clause-② narrowing exists. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no protocol file is touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Lint UI not added (dev flag): answered and in-ruling. Ruling 6545651687 letter A binds Lint UI only "if the dev measures that ui's eslint reads these packages"; measured no. The dev's wider observation is correct and read in the tree: Lint UI's other steps DO read the seven, namely `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` (ci.yml:4167) and the `check:skill-examples` / `check:doc-snippets` builds whose `--build-filter` closures include the `@objectstack/*` dists (:4214-4289), so a spec change can still red Lint UI first on a bystander's ui PR. Outside the ruling's letter (eslint only); escalated to the domain:devx seat as carrier; should-fix at most, not a FAIL. `spec-liveness-check.yml:58` already runs the liveness check on spec-side diffs, so that one step is not unguarded.
- Root files not in `ui:` (`.npmrc`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `vitest.preset.mts`, `patches/**` etc.; dev flag): the selector turns full for them (select-affected-tests.mjs:548-556) but the shards never start. Correctly scoped out of this ruling; escalated to the seat with dedupe words. Not acted on, rightly.
- No permanent pin reconciling `ui_consumers` against the selector's package graph (dev flag): consistent with the ruling declining option B's second list and its reconciling gate; the `test-ui-gate` change is the in-surface regression check instead. Accepted.
- Assignees none (dev flag): a seat matter, no judgment owed here.
- `open_questions`: none in the body.
- Runner-minute cost (ruling requirement): stated against #25869 / #25881 with measured numbers. One should-fix on the prose only: the "at least ~376 per merge" count names one PR-head run and one queue entry, but `push: branches: [main]` (ci.yml:4-6) also runs the shards on the merged commit (a ui_consumers-only merge previously skipped them there too), so the per-merge floor is closer to ~564 runner-min, and the daily lower bound is correspondingly higher. "At least" keeps the sentence true; the decomposition undercounts. Not a tree defect.

### ④ Design judgment

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the only `hits` file), held against the ruling scenario (6545651687 letter A, adopting 6529967823): a diff confined to packages/lint/** (or any of the seven) starts the Test UI shards on the PR and in the queue, with the same shape the other ui jobs use, which tests run left to the selector, and the derivation / parity gates updated in the same PR.

- Holds on the PR event: a packages/lint-only diff yields ui=false, ui_consumers=true; the new `if:` runs the shards; the select step diffs against merge-base(origin/main, HEAD); `outsideTreeReasons` names `@objectstack/lint changed, and this tree's tests read its built output`; mode=full; sixteen shards run the whole suite including AutomationsPillar.problemsAgree-27799.test.tsx. The #28192 → #28197 scenario is closed.
- Holds in the queue: on merge_group the ui outputs come from the queue diff against `merge_group.base_sha`; the same ui_consumers=true starts the shards; the select step uses `QUEUE_BASE`; full battery. If the queue diff step fails, outputs are empty, `!= 'false'` runs the shards: fail-open preserved.
- Holds on push to main: the full battery runs (select step's `*` branch); formerly skipped for seven-package-only merges, now run. A cost, not a defect.
- Gate consistency: tried each (ui_tree, ui, ui_consumers) combination; the shell condition is the exact complement of the shards' `if:` and no combination lets a skipped rollup pass that the `if:` would have started. The failed-filter branch stays red. `name: Test UI` and `if: always()` untouched, so the required context still publishes.
- Attempted break, selector disagreement: a ui_consumers-only diff cannot start the shards and then select an empty affected set: any outer-package file reached by the graph is a `reasons` entry and `reasons.length > 0` forces full before the affected path is computed (:662-698); an unresolvable parse is also full; the step's fail-open wrapper treats any non-verdict as full.
- Attempted break, parser refusal: the spelling used is the one the fixture at check-expected-skips.mjs:1318 already accepts and the self-test at :1526 pins; refusal is not possible for this line.
- Attempted break, comment claims: the new comment above `test-ui` and the two edited comments in `filter` and `ui_consumers` match the code they describe; the ui-deps header's union claim (:3323-3324) and the filter header's "five ui jobs" remain true. "Lint UI keeps `ui` alone: its eslint reads none of the seven" is literally true and does not claim Lint UI as a whole reads none.
- Should-fix (prose, carried to the seat, not blocking): the per-merge runner-minute decomposition omits the push-to-main run (③ above); the Lint UI residue is a card for the devx seat as the dev names.
- Must-fix: none.

Check-runs on the head at review time: `filter`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Auto Label`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Lint · ESLint` and the three `Lint · scoped` jobs concluded success; `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Build UI Deps`, `Live E2E UI`, `Test Core (1/8)`, the four `Type Check ·` jobs and four `Lint ·` jobs were in_progress; the `Test UI (k/16)` shards, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI` and `Build & E2E UI` had not yet been created (they wait on Build UI Deps). No check-run had failed. An in-progress run is not a pass; this verdict is on the design and the diff, and the Tier H landing still waits on every gate family concluding green on this head and the maintainer's approval.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-cbuqpy`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QUs3BsPpUdAGmm7wLdoKaK`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT

Reviewed head `33b9f44f31` against `origin/main` for #28220 (ruling 6545651687, letter A; claim on the card, branch `claude/project-thread-cbuqpy`).

| Check | Reading |
|---|---|
| Path surface (`/pulls/28501/files`) | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` +36/−14 only — inside the claimed surface; the dev's transient `ui/scripts` pin was dropped before the head |
| Governed | `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28501` → ⛔ GOVERNED, 50 changed lines: **a human merge is the review record**. The seat does not approve, queue or merge this PR |
| Ruling fit | `test-ui` `if:` now `ui_tree != 'false' && (ui != 'false' \|\| ui_consumers != 'false')` — the shape Build UI Deps / Type Check UI / Build & E2E UI already read. Not taken: B's hand list, C's import-precise selection |
| Aggregate consistency | the `Test UI` verdict explains `skipped` only when `ui_tree='false'` or both `ui` and `ui_consumers` are `'false'` — the exact negation of the shards' `if:`; an empty output (filter step failed) still runs the shards |
| Lint UI | kept on `ui` alone: its eslint reads none of the seven (dev's measurement); see the noted finding below |
| Derivations | `check-expected-skips` and CI filter parity derive from the workflow, so no edit was needed; `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are green on this head |
| Live proof | this head's own run started all sixteen `Test UI` shards, 16/16 success, aggregate success |
| Contract review | PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, record 6552512600 |

**Correction the seat carries (dev's should-fix, not patched into the body):** the per-merge cost in the body ("~376 runner-min", PR head + queue) omits the `push` run on `main`, which also starts the full battery for these diffs. The floor is **~564 runner-min per such merge** (3 × ~188), so the daily lower bound at 22–31 such merges is roughly **12,400–17,500 runner-min**, not 8,300–11,700.

**Noted, not filed (seat is carrier):**
1. `Lint UI`'s non-eslint steps (spec `check:liveness`, doc-snippet / skill-example type checks) do read the seven packages, so the same skip gap exists there at a smaller scale.
2. Root non-doc files and `patches/**` make the ui selector answer `mode=full` but start no `Test UI` shards.

Verdict: ACCEPT. Landing waits on the maintainer's merge (Tier H).
